question: What areas do you serve?
answer: MTC Renovations serves Burlington, Hamilton, Oakville, Milton, Mississauga, and Toronto, plus Stoney Creek, Ancaster, Dundas, Waterdown, and Grimsby. We also serve nearby communities including Binbrook, Caledonia, Flamborough, Winona, Beamsville, Lincoln, and Brantford. We do not publish a street address, and we do not list an office in Mississauga or Toronto. If you are unsure whether we serve your neighbourhood, give us a call at (647) 560-1095 or fill out our free quote form — we will let you know right away. We are a local Ontario team, not a franchise, so you always deal directly with our crew.
